content.text: Antes de começarmos, vamos relembrar alguns conceitos importantes para falar sobre hábitos, interesses e experiências passadas.
: usado para descrever hábitos e rotinas.
She plays the guitar every day.
always, usually, often, sometimes, rarely, never
I always listen to music before bed.
He sometimes plays soccer with friends.
: usados para narrar ações concluídas no passado.
I went to the park yesterday.
She saw a great movie last night.
: usado para ações passadas que têm ligação ou impacto no presente.
I have seen that movie several times.
Aprender vocabulário para falar sobre hobbies, interesses e rotinas usando advérbios de frequência.
Praticar o uso correto dos verbos irregulares no passado simples e seus particípios.
Desenvolver a habilidade de contar histórias e relatar experiências pessoais com mais naturalidade.
Usar estruturas do present simple, past simple e present perfect para expressar hábitos e experiências.
Vocabulário básico de hobbies e interesses
Atividades físicas: running, swimming, hiking, yoga, cycling, playing soccer/basketball/tennis
Atividades artísticas: painting, drawing, playing an instrument, singing, dancing, acting
Atividades intelectuais: reading, writing, learning languages, playing chess
Culinária: cooking, baking, trying new recipes
Viagens: traveling, visiting museums, exploring new places
I always drink coffee in the morning.
I sometimes go to the beach.
Verbos irregulares mais comuns (passado simples e particípio passado)
I went to the beach last summer.
She saw a great play yesterday.
They did their homework last night.
He took photos during his trip.
We ate at a fancy restaurant.
My friend came to visit last month.
I wrote a letter to my pen pal.
He broke his phone last week.
What do you usually do in your free time?
How often do you play sports or practice hobbies?
Can you tell me about a memorable trip or experience you had?
Have you ever broken something important? What happened?
What new hobby would you like to try?
Complete as frases com o advérbio correto:
I ____ listen to music before bed. (sempre)
We ____ go on vacation in December. (geralmente)
They ____ go hiking in the mountains. (raramente)
C. Complete com o verbo irregular correto
I ______ (go) to the concert last night.
They have ______ (take) many photos during their trip.
We have ______ (meet) many interesting people recently.
Escreva um parágrafo (5-6 frases) falando sobre seus hobbies usando advérbios de frequência.
Traduza as frases para o inglês usando verbos irregulares e advérbios:
“Eu já vi esse filme várias vezes.”
Complete com o verbo irregular correto:
She ______ (come) to my party last weekend.
We have ______ (do) a lot of fun during our vacation.
He ______ (write) a letter to his friend.
I have ______ (see) that movie several times.
Escreva um texto de 150-200 palavras contando uma experiência inesquecível, usando pelo menos 8 verbos irregulares diferentes no passado simples e/ou present perfect.
Grave um áudio falando sobre seus hobbies, rotina e uma experiência passada que tenha marcado você. Use advérbios de frequência e verbos irregulares.
